description: The tsl acquire path landed in 8141f91 (EndfLibrary::thermal_url, well_known_tsl, EndfCache::fetch_tsl/fetch_tsl_by_name/download_tsl_tape). Remaining: make the LIVE thermal tests use it so they download portably instead of soft-skipping on a hardcoded path. Targets: outram-mc pincell.rs (op-6tz.12, tsl-HinH2O) and njoy thermal_graphite_coherent.rs (graphite MAT 30/31/32). Wiring must be cfg(feature=net-fetch)-gated (EndfCache is net-fetch-only) so the non-net-fetch build + local-tape path still work, and must catch a download error and SKIP (not fail) so offline CI stays green. NOT verifiable on this host: IAEA www-nds.iaea.org is policy-blocked (403); verify the actual download + the tsl/ URL spelling on a network-capable machine on first fetch.
title: Wire the LIVE thermal tests to EndfCache::fetch_tsl (portable auto-download)

description:
Umbrella for giving tampines::components real physical dimensions.

FINDING (2026-08-03, while designing the digital-twin widget library): only Pipe carries real geometry (diameter, length, inclination, roughness -- crates/tampines/src/components/pipe.rs:37-43). HeatExchanger (heat_exchanger.rs:20) and SteamGenerator (via heat_exchanger.area) carry a heat-TRANSFER Area only, which is not an envelope -- a compact plate HX and a large shell-and-tube can share an area. Pump, Turbine, Valve, Condenser and CoolingTower carry no dimensional data at all.

WHY THIS BLOCKS THE WIDGET LIBRARY: outram-park-digital-twin-engine renders 'visual process objects whose rendering derives directly from physics state'. Its crate CLAUDE.md forbids new physics in the engine, so any dimension a widget needs must be added HERE, in tampines.

THE TRAP TO AVOID: HemSteamCv::get_volume() is reachable from Turbine (turbine.inlet) and SteamGenerator (secondary_side), but it is the THERMODYNAMIC control volume -- caller-supplied, unvalidated, used only to convert intensive to extensive properties (get_mass() = volume / specific_volume). The codebase convention is a 1 m3 dummy (TampinesSteamTableCV::get_ref_vol() returns exactly 1.0 m3) and Turbine::new never sets or scales it. Sizing a widget on it would draw every turbine identically at 1 m3. It represents the fluid parcel, not the machine casing. Do NOT use it for visual size.

Each child bead adds an honest envelope/size to one component. Prefer explicit named dimensions (casing length/diameter, shell height, footprint) over a bare Volume where the shape matters to the drawing; a single nominal Volume is acceptable where a rough size correlation is all that is wanted.
title: tampines components: physical size/volume representation for visualization

description: Shared foundation for op-et4 (njoy) + op-z5q (outram-mc) TUIs. Mobile-FIRST: designed for a phone screen, driven by TOUCH (tap to select, drag/flick to scroll, pinch/zoom on plots where feasible) not keyboard-only. Termux mouse/SGR-1006 events in ratatui/crossterm map touch->click/scroll. Layout adapts to narrow terminals. Android/Termux build rule applies (TUI in-scope on Android).
title: TUIs: mobile-first touchscreen interaction layer (ratatui + Termux)
